caption: A process's segment table, one base and limit row per segment. Segment 2, base 90 and limit 100, is used in the worked example; segment 1 has limit 14, so almost any access to it traps.

spec.title: Segment table for four segments
spec.aria: The segment table lists base and limit for segments 0 to 3; segment 2 has base 90 and limit 100, which is the row used in the worked example.
